briefing:
# Pre-meeting briefing: Shopify, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** News, launches, hires and deals from roughly 17 October to 17 November 2026, drawn only from the search results provided. Earnings-call content was not reviewed.

## What changed

**Financial results (Q3, quarter to 30 Sept 2026)**
- Revenue grew 32% (32% in constant currency), and free cash flow margin was 22%. (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow)
- Per a third-party summary of the 10-Q, Shopify Payments carried 68% of $119B in GMV. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-shopify-filing-shopify-payments-carried-68-of-119b-in-gmv)
- Pre-results guidance was for revenue growth in the low thirties, operating expenses at 33–34% of revenue, and a free cash flow margin in the high teens to low twenties. (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/29/ai-boom-or-margin-bust-the-hidden-catalysts-set-to-move-shopify-stock-nov-3)
- A headline reads "Shopify Plunges 17% as GMV and Subscription Revenue Miss Estimates," but the results do not give a URL for it, so I have not relied on it.

**Deals and partnerships**
- A report says a company was agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4B, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced) **Caution:** the snippet does not name Shopify. Confirm the target before raising this.
- lululemon added Shop Pay to its US and Canadian e-commerce sites. (https://retailtechinnovationhub.com/home/2026/11/1/who-will-be-the-ai-winners-this-holiday-season-last-weeks-most-read-retail-technology-articles)

**Launches and product**
- Shopify is extending into merchant advertising, with a pay-per-sale model that its VP of product for merchant marketing says takes on media risk. Shopify has also added SEO to the product. (https://ppc.land/googles-core-update-may-run-until-three-days-before-black-friday)
- Background from before the window: on 21 September, Shopify and Meta announced merchants can sell inside Meta's AI assistant Muse, with Shop Pay handling checkout. (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/29/ai-boom-or-margin-bust-the-hidden-catalysts-set-to-move-shopify-stock-nov-3)

**Hires and headcount**
- Headcount is 30,025, up 5,330 (21.6%) over the year and up 1,499 in the quarter. The source page is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/yIg9BumgrtmF)
- I found no specific executive hires in the results.

**Source gaps:** The two dates for the Q3 press release conflict. Its metadata says 21 October, but the text refers to results announced 3 November. The 3 November date is consistent with the call and the 10-Q.

## Open questions

1. Is Shopify a party to the reported $9.4B Globex transaction, and if so, what does the deal mean for merchant and partner commitments during the close period?
2. How is the pay-per-sale advertising model performing against the Q3 guidance and the 17% share price fall, and what GMV and subscription metrics are behind the reported miss?
3. With Shop Pay now in large retailers such as lululemon and inside Meta's Muse, where do we fit in its checkout and marketing roadmap, and what integration or co-marketing support is available for us?
